omEnvelope.phenomenonTime: derived from the timestamp encoded in the image filename

currentRuntimeContract.timeFieldNote: The SWE DataRecord time field named timestamp is mapped from phenomenonTime and is intentionally omitted from the result body.

recommendedConservativeEnrichment.approach: Keep the runtime result body unchanged and enrich metadata at the datastream, deployment, and camera-sidecar levels.
reasons: The current result body already contains the fields a renderer needs for live imagery.
Keeping the result body small reduces downstream contract churn.
Camera cadence, selection, and provenance fit better as metadata than as repeated observation fields.

futureOptionalRuntimeExtensions.adoptionGuidance: Add only if a real consumer needs richer audit, selection, or display behavior than the current URL-focused observation contract provides.

importantConstraint: Current dedupe is keyed by nwisId and the outputName is fixed, so the runtime contract assumes one selected camera per station system.
